affiliations.occupation: Farm hand on a general farm
affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation code 316 recorded at Army entry on April 16, 1943; no farm, owner, employer, location, or start date is named.
affiliations.research_notes: Exact private-identifier and name agreement confirms the indexed person. The occupation code cannot support a named farm employer or an immediate Army-to-OSS pathway.

claims.claim_text: Exact private-identifier agreement confirms the indexed Conley E. Bowman identity in the official Army merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index and Army record share the exact private identifier, full name, and middle initial.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed through exact private-identifier and name agreement across official records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record dates entry to April 16, 1943; it does not establish the later Army-to-OSS assignment date.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier remains masked publicly. The index's Pfc grade may reflect later promotion and does not conflict with private-at-entry grade.

claims.claim_text: The official Army entry record places Conley E. Bowman in the broad civilian group for farm hands on general farms.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Code 316 was recorded at Army entry on April 16, 1943 and maps to farm hands on general farms.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed exact private-identifier and name match.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded at Army entry; not a named employer and not proven to be the immediate predecessor to OSS.
claims.match_notes: No farm, owner, employer, location, duties beyond the broad code, or Army-to-OSS sequence is inferred.

research_attempts.query_text: Robert H Bowers P-2: visually verified NARA OSS index; official and CIA Reading Room checks; exact-name OSS variants; federal, employer, occupation, obituary, directory, newspaper, institutional, and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: The civilian grade and common name cannot distinguish military memorials, later tax professionals, and other namesakes without direct OSS linkage or corroborating identifiers.

research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 72 for identity, duties, and employment chronology.
